title: Sparkly teapot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF9C4' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFF9C4' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFF9C4'>
    <polygon points='20,20 22,26 28,26 23,30 25,36 20,32 15,36 17,30 12,26 18,26'/>
    <polygon points='80,15 81.5,19 85.5,19 82.5,21.5 83.5,25.5 80,23 76.5,25.5 77.5,21.5 74.5,19 78.5,19'/>
    <polygon points='85,70 86.5,74 90.5,74 87.5,76.5 88.5,80.5 85,78 81.5,80.5 82.5,76.5 79.5,74 83.5,74'/>
    <polygon points='15,75 16.5,79 20.5,79 17.5,81.5 18.5,85.5 15,83 11.5,85.5 12.5,81.5 9.5,79 13.5,79'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='60' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='75' cy='55' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='25' cy='45' r='1.5'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Glow behind teapot -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='35' ry='20' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Teapot body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#FF6B8A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#FF8FA8' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Highlight on body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='56' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#FFB3C6' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Teapot lid -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='16' ry='5' fill='#E64A6E'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='16' ry='5' fill='#FF7A9A' opacity='0.4'/>
  
  <!-- Lid knob -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='39' r='4' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#FFE599'/>

  <!-- Spout -->
  <path d='M74 56 Q84 50 86 42 Q87 38 84 38' stroke='#FF6B8A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M74 56 Q84 50 86 42 Q87 38 84 38' stroke='#FF8FA8' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Handle -->
  <path d='M26 54 Q12 54 12 64 Q12 74 26 70' stroke='#FF6B8A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M26 54 Q12 54 12 64 Q12 74 26 70' stroke='#FF8FA8' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='14' ry='4' fill='#E64A6E'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='77' rx='14' ry='3' fill='#FF7A9A' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Decorative dots on teapot -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='65' r='2' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='67' r='2' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='65' r='2' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#FFE599'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#FFE599'/>
</svg>
